newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on bullish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on bullish sentiment.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Wednesday's new accounts day on bullish sentiment in blue chips, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.
The KSE 100-share index ended 8.84 points, or 0.58 percent, up at 1,541.89 amid 195 losers and 81 gainer in a turnover of 72 million shares compared to 59.47 million on Tueday.
Fresh buying interest in selected blue chips by investors kept the market sentiment bullish, dealer Faisal Abbas said.
"It would be appropriate to go long and hold on for pre-budget rallies." dealer Ali Raza of Kausar Abbas Bhayani Securities said, referring to the Pakistan buget in June.

Adamjee Insurance dipped 0.50 to 115.50 rupees after it announced 20 percent final dividend and 25 percent bonus issues in addition to 15 percent interim cash dividend for the year ended in December. ICI rose 0.60 to 24.35, PTCL 0.10 to 24.75, DS Fibre 0.90 to 35.65 and Fauji Fertilizer two to 83.
